scripts.dev: npm run build -w @studio/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,server,web "npm run dev -w @studio/contracts" "npm run dev -w @studio/server" "npm run dev -w @studio/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @studio/contracts && npm run build -w @studio/server && npm run build -w @studio/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @studio/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc --noEmit
